message.content: In one of LiHua's most memorable matches in "Call of Duty: Warzone," he described a situation where his team was down to just two members, yet they managed to outsmart the opposing team. This match showcased a great team effort, and LiHua emphasized the importance of planning and strategy in the game. Despite being outnumbered, his team's teamwork and clever maneuvers allowed them to secure victory. LiHua found this particular match particularly exhilarating due to the intense final moments and the adrenaline rush experienced during the last circle.
